Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes This PR focuses the mobile composer’s existing textarea during the initial pointer gesture before expanding the editor. **Example:** Tap the compact mobile composer, then type “First tap is ready to type”. - **Before:** The composer can expand before native focus, leaving the software keyboard closed. - **After:** The handler focuses the textarea before expansion, preserving the draft without sending it. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | A useful, minimal repair with no actionable code finding; validation supports the focus-ordering invariant at the browser-harness boundary. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | This collaborator-authored bot PR is outside the ordinary contributor proof gate; its reported browser runs exercise the production composer with a mock Gateway, while the inspected linked media covers earlier agent-creation behavior. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Tapping the compact mobile composer can expand the editor without opening the keyboard. **Reason:** First-tap editing is an expected composer behavior, and the maintainer-authored repair preserves the existing interaction design with a narrowly scoped change. ## Regression provenance Possible regression — suspected (reviewed change). No predecessor PR is attributed. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep open: this maintainer-authored PR addresses a current mobile focus-ordering defect with a minimal change, and no introduced runtime defect was found. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `d3eb91121e0eafdf793de621b20f8dc957e8eacc` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None. ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: A physical iPhone run showing the keyboard opening on the first compact-composer tap remains unverified; the supplied browser tests establish focus ordering instead.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The Control UI’s existing mobile interaction owner receives pointer and focus events, controls composer expansion, and retains the textarea used for drafting messages. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Mobile textarea tap] --> B[Document pointer capture] B --> C[Existing mobile interaction owner] C --> D[Focus retained textarea] D --> E[Expand composer] E --> F[Continue editing draft] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Retain the synchronous focus call in the existing interaction owner and merge after the existing exact-head checks pass. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Source inspection establishes expansion before explicit focus on current main, and the PR reports a red-to-green browser regression; this review did not execute target code. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The change repairs ordering at the existing owner without new state, listeners, timers, or competing focus policy, while retaining disabled/read-only protection and drawer recovery. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [013240515205](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/013240515205573248c27ab6b8eec7303f0da1a8). ### Provenance checked - `Mobile composer pointer activation` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (413d2fc66983d396ff1e9281f568954ef3c83de6: The mobile hunk in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175291 restored editing after drawer closure even when no new focusin event occurs; the interaction owner originated in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176498.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Minimal production repair:** The introduced diff adds synchronous focus before changeEditing while preserving the mobile-only, primary-button, textarea-identity, and editable checks. ([`ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer-mobile-interaction.tsx:182`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d3eb91121e0eafdf793de621b20f8dc957e8eacc/ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer-mobile-interaction.tsx#L182), [d3eb91121e0e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d3eb91121e0eafdf793de621b20f8dc957e8eacc)) - **Current main retains the ordering defect:** Fetched main expands the composer in pointerdown without explicitly focusing it first; the separate composer-chrome helper leaves interactive textarea gestures to native handling. ([`ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer-mobile-interaction.tsx:182`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/013240515205573248c27ab6b8eec7303f0da1a8/ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer-mobile-interaction.tsx#L182), [013240515205](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/013240515205573248c27ab6b8eec7303f0da1a8)) - **Earlier recovery behavior is preserved:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175291 removed the already-focused condition to restore editing after drawer closure; this PR retains that behavior rather than restoring the condition. ([`ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer-mobile-interaction.tsx:179`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/413d2fc66983d396ff1e9281f568954ef3c83de6/ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer-mobile-interaction.tsx#L179), [413d2fc66983](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/413d2fc66983d396ff1e9281f568954ef3c83de6)) - **Focused regression coverage:** The new production-bundle browser case checks focus during pointerdown, editing activation, subsequent typing, and absence of chat.send; the existing caret/menu suite gains the ordering assertion and WebKit inclusion. Passing results and the red baseline are contributor-reported, not independently executed in this read-only review. ([`ui/src/e2e/chat-composer-pointer-activation.e2e.test.ts:255`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d3eb91121e0eafdf793de621b20f8dc957e8eacc/ui/src/e2e/chat-composer-pointer-activation.e2e.test.ts#L255), [d3eb91121e0e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d3eb91121e0eafdf793de621b20f8dc957e8eacc)) - **Prepared media belongs to earlier agent-creation work:** The three inspected screenshots depict selector, Claws, and agent-creation changes from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175291.
